description: Take a role away from a member. Preflights the bot's role hierarchy so a failure is an explanation, not a 403. Usually done at once. A role can also hold someone back (one that hides channels from whoever has it, such as a quarantine role); taking that away lets them in, so it needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

reason.description: The reason recorded in the server's audit log.

name: remove_role
title: Remove role
